verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents first-party APIs for its core functions: standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs for calculating, recording, and reversing tax, and a Tax Registrations API offered alongside the Dashboard's Locations tab, which shows API/UI parity for registrations. However, nothing documents API parity for reports and itemized exports, nexus monitoring insights, Stripe-managed registration, or filing, and there is no general parity statement. missing for 10: documented API equivalents for reports/exports, monitoring insights, registering-on-your-behalf and filing; an explicit API/UI parity commitment; independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs lets you calculate tax, record transactions, and handle reversals directly.
add your registrations to Stripe using the Locations tab in the Dashboard or Tax Registrations API
The API returns the reason for a tax result in the taxability_reason field.
